001: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the city center?

You need Teatralnaya station, it's right in the center.
And is it far to walk from the metro to the main street?
No, it's only a five-minute walk, so don't worry.

Yes, it does, but you'd better take the next one, this one is packed.
And how often do they come?
Every ten minutes, so you won't have to wait long.
Great, then I'll wait for the next one.
Good call, it'll be much more comfortable.
003: Excuse me, where's the nearest tram stop?
It's right around the corner, next to that yellow building.

The fifth or the seventh will work, both go that way.

Forty rubles, but you can also pay by card.

Yes, almost every day, it's the most convenient.

Yes, that's right, this train goes straight to the airport.

About forty minutes, so you can just relax.

Yes, it's the last stop, so you won't miss your station.

Only four, that's about fifteen minutes.

Yes, about half an hour, but it's good for your health.

No, this route doesn't go there, you need a different one.

No, it's still running, it closes at one in the morning.

I think so, if we hurry, we still have time.

Agreed, the metro is both faster and cheaper.

Take the bus and get off at the fifth stop.
And is it far from here?
No, about twenty minutes, no more.

Yes, it'll be right across from you, you can't miss it.
010: Do you usually take a taxi or public transportation?
I try to use public transportation, it's cheaper.

I get it, sometimes it really saves you.
